environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a private subnet with VPC DNS resolution enabled. The container has network access to the EC2 metadata service (169.254.169.254) and internal services on 10.0.0.0/8. No DNS filtering or response policy zones configured. The task role has s3:GetObject and secretsmanager:GetSecretValue permissions. Standard ALB forwards all traffic to the container on port 8080 with no additional inspection rules.
